title: Feedback on Streaks for Mac
body:
I’ve been a happy Streaks user on iOS, so I was excited to see a Mac version. While the app works and syncs well, there are a few areas that could improve the Mac experience:
	1.	The menubar icon opens a separate, resizable window instead of an integrated pop-up. It feels less polished compared to other menubar apps.
	2.	There’s no option to launch the app at startup, which is essential for habit tracking.
	3.	The window resizing feels unnecessary for a menubar app; a fixed size would be more user-friendly.

Streaks is a great app, but I hope the Mac version gets updates to better suit the platform. I’d love to see these adjustments in future releases!
